name: codexkit
description: CodexKit plugin for scaffolding repositories, using local CodexKit workflows, discovering shipped skills, and setting up local Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold repos, use workflows, and set up Codex.
interface.longDescription: Provides Codex-native setup flows for project scaffolding, local workflow routing inside scaffolded repositories, workspace plugin installation, local skill management, and shipped skill discovery.
defaultPrompt: Use CodexKit to set up this repository for Codex and install the workspace plugin.
Use CodexKit to list, search, install, or sync the shipped CodexKit skills.
If this repository already has CodexKit workflows, follow the local workflow files in .agents/workflows before falling back to scaffold commands.
